In total of 7 expeditions have gone underway since 2023 under the ALONGate project:

- PS148 (2025) HAUSGARTEN LTER, Polarstern
- PS155 (2026) HAUSGARTEN LTER, Polarstern
- MSM145 (2026) Circum-Iceland, deployment of three BLOS at natural coral reef, artificial reef at fishing closure area, and at hydrothermal vent

More are coming in the future

- 2027: recover and re-deployment of the BLOS around iceland
- 2028: benthic sampling of the southern transect
